beginner.title: Tabata Foundation

scaling.easier: Step jacks instead of jumping jacks; knee push-ups; reduce squat depth
scaling.harder: Add 3rd station; reduce rest between stations to 30s

beginner.coaching_cue: Push the 20s — the 10s is yours, not a head start on the next round.
beginner.format: Tabata — 20s work / 10s rest × 8 rounds per station
beginner.intent: introduce Tabata protocol via bodyweight
beginner.progression_hint: Week 1 foundation — repeat until all 4 stations complete with consistent rep counts before advancing to hiit-b-06

beginner.title: Run The Clock

scaling.easier: Replace sprint with brisk walk; reduce to 5 rounds
scaling.harder: 45s sprint / 75s walk; add 2 rounds

beginner.coaching_cue: Sprint pace should be uncomfortable, not unsustainable — find the edge and hold it.
beginner.intent: sprint interval adaptation for beginners
beginner.progression_hint: Use in week 1-2 as first sprint exposure; progress to hiit-b-08 when all 8 rounds feel controlled

beginner.title: EMOM The 12 — Air Squat + Burpee

scaling.easier: 8 squats + 2 burpees; knee push-ups; reduce sit-up to crunch
scaling.harder: Add 2 reps per exercise per round (progressive EMOM)

beginner.coaching_cue: Finish each minute with at least 10 seconds spare — if you can't, reduce the reps now.
beginner.intent: aerobic + muscular endurance via EMOM pacing
beginner.progression_hint: Entry EMOM — if 10+ seconds rest per minute achieved consistently, progress rep count or advance to hiit-b-07

beginner.title: Step-Up Interval Pairs

scaling.easier: Air squat instead of jump squat; march in place instead of high knees
scaling.harder: Add third block: lateral hop 20s / 10s rest

beginner.coaching_cue: Land every jump squat softly — flat-foot landings send the impact straight to your knees.
beginner.intent: lower-body power and metabolic output
beginner.progression_hint: Introduce plyometric loading in week 2-3; leads into hiit-b-05 when jump squat landings are controlled

beginner.title: Short Ladder

scaling.easier: Step burpee; air squat instead of squat jump; cap at rung 3
scaling.harder: Add a 6th rung (12 reps); reduce rest to 60s

beginner.coaching_cue: Breathe at the top of every burpee — it costs one second and saves the entire set.
beginner.intent: ascending volume tolerance under fatigue
beginner.progression_hint: Use mid-block after sprint and Tabata exposure; precedes chipper-style work in intermediate tier

beginner.title: Station Break

scaling.easier: Knee push-up; reduce step height; plank instead of hollow body
scaling.harder: Increase to 5 rounds; reduce station rest to 15s

beginner.coaching_cue: Every station is a clean start — reset your breathing between stations, not mid-exercise.
beginner.intent: full-body circuit with multi-planar movement
beginner.progression_hint: Station format builds circuit fluency; advance to hiit-b-09 when all 4 rounds are completed with 15+ seconds per station to spare

beginner.title: Double AMRAP

structure.note: Match or beat AMRAP 10 round count in AMRAP 5

scaling.easier: Step jacks; knee push-ups; squat pulse instead of hop
scaling.harder: Reduce AMRAP 10 rest to 3 min; target +2 rounds in AMRAP 5

beginner.coaching_cue: Track your round count in AMRAP 10 — the AMRAP 5 score tells you how well you paced.
beginner.intent: pacing strategy development via dual AMRAP
beginner.progression_hint: Teaches effort management — a key skill before progressing to threshold intervals; use in week 3-4

beginner.title: Effort Ladder

scaling.easier: 7/10 = brisk walk; 9/10 = fastest walk possible; reduce to 4 rounds
scaling.harder: 6 rounds; extend hard phase to 90s

beginner.coaching_cue: 9/10 effort is the fastest you can sustain for 60 seconds — not a 5-second sprint.
beginner.intent: progressive effort ramp for aerobic threshold development
beginner.progression_hint: Bridges beginner sprint work to sustained-effort intervals; prepares athlete for hiit-i-06 threshold protocol

beginner.title: Push–Pull Tabata Pairs

scaling.easier: Knee push-up; bench dip; static lunge
scaling.harder: Add pair C: DB thruster + sit-up

beginner.coaching_cue: In Tabata, consistent reps across all 8 rounds beats blowing up in round 1 — start at 70%.
beginner.format: Tabata pairs — 20s on / 10s off × 8 rounds per pair
beginner.intent: push-pull Tabata pairing for balanced upper-body stimulus
beginner.progression_hint: Second Tabata exposure with movement variety; graduate to hiit-i-01 when pair B rep counts match pair A

beginner.title: Breathless 15

structure.rest: Only when needed — rest as little as possible

scaling.easier: Start at 12-9-6-4-2; knee push-ups
scaling.harder: Add tuck jumps to the squat; no rest at all

beginner.coaching_cue: Breathe between movements, not mid-rep — broken rhythm costs more time than a 10-second breath.
beginner.intent: descending ladder to build glycolytic finishing capacity
beginner.progression_hint: Final beginner HIIT session — benchmark for entry into intermediate tier when completed sub-12 min

intermediate.title: Tabata Complex
intermediate.format: Tabata — 20s work / 10s rest × 8 rounds per station, 3 stations

scaling.easier: Lighter KB (16/12 kg); step-up instead of box jump; rower or ski erg
scaling.harder: Heavier KB (28/24 kg); 30-inch box; reduce rest to 90s

intermediate.coaching_cue: KB swing: hips snap, arms follow — pulling with your arms kills the power before it starts.
intermediate.intent: Tabata intensity upgrade with loaded implements
intermediate.progression_hint: First intermediate Tabata — establishes KB and bike baseline; advance when all 3 stations maintain 8+ quality reps per round

intermediate.title: Fight Gone Bad
intermediate.format: 3 rounds × 5 stations × 1 min each, 1 min rest between rounds

structure.score: total reps + calories across all rounds

scaling.easier: Lighter loads (20/15 kg); step-ups; DB push press
scaling.harder: Increase to 4 rounds; chase a score above 300 reps

intermediate.coaching_cue: Rotate stations with zero dead time — the 1-min rest is the only full stop you get.
intermediate.intent: maximal work capacity across five modalities
intermediate.progression_hint: Benchmark session — retest every 6 weeks; a score above 300 total reps signals readiness for longer chipper formats

intermediate.title: KB Gauntlet
intermediate.format: 5 rounds × 4 stations × 40s work / 20s rest

scaling.easier: Lighter KB (20/16 kg); two-hand clean; step hop over KB
scaling.harder: Heavier KB (28/24 kg); increase rounds to 6

intermediate.coaching_cue: Goblet squat: elbows inside knees, chest tall — the KB will pull you forward if your brace fails.
intermediate.intent: sustained KB metabolic output across five rounds
intermediate.progression_hint: Mid-block KB density work; progress to heavier bell or 6 rounds when rest periods feel excessive between rounds

intermediate.title: Bike Pyramid
intermediate.format: 3 rounds of ascending/descending max effort intervals

scaling.easier: Rower substitute; reduce top-end effort to 85%; 2 rounds
scaling.harder: Full 4 rounds; hold same watt target across all intervals

intermediate.coaching_cue: The first 3 seconds of each max effort establish your power — don't ramp, explode from zero.
intermediate.intent: peak power development via short max-effort bike pyramids
intermediate.progression_hint: Teaches power curve management; precedes repeated sprint ability work — advance when watt output holds across all three rounds

intermediate.title: Engine Test
intermediate.format: EMOM 20

structure.note: Reduce target if less than 10s rest remains in any minute

scaling.easier: 10 cal row; step-overs instead of jump-overs; 18-min EMOM
scaling.harder: 18 cal row; 15 burpee box jump-overs; hold 8-10s rest throughout

intermediate.coaching_cue: You should finish each minute with 8–10s spare — if you don't, drop the target by 2 immediately.
intermediate.intent: aerobic engine stress test under concurrent demands
intermediate.progression_hint: EMOM benchmark — if 10+ seconds rest per minute is achieved throughout, increase row target to 17 cal and jump-overs to 14

intermediate.title: Threshold Intervals
intermediate.format: 5 rounds of sustained effort / active recovery

scaling.easier: 3 min at 7/10 RPE / 3 min easy; 4 rounds
scaling.harder: 6 rounds; target the same split/pace each 4-min block

intermediate.coaching_cue: 8/10 effort means you can say one word but not a sentence — find that line and live there for 4 minutes.
intermediate.intent: lactate threshold development via sustained hard efforts
intermediate.progression_hint: Core threshold session for intermediate block; progress to 6 rounds or tighten rest to 90s when pace holds across all 5 efforts

intermediate.title: KB Clean-Press-Swing Total
intermediate.format: 5 rounds for quality

exercises.name: KB Clean and Press — each arm (20/16 kg)

scaling.easier: Lighter KB (16/12 kg); two-hand swing; separate clean and press
scaling.harder: Increase rounds to 6; add Turkish get-up 2 per side each round

intermediate.coaching_cue: Clean-and-press: the press is strict — zero leg drive. If you push-press it, the clean weight is too heavy.
intermediate.intent: KB strength-endurance complex under accumulated fatigue
intermediate.progression_hint: Bridges HIIT conditioning into loaded strength work; advance KB weight when all 5 rounds maintain strict press form

intermediate.title: Row and Burn
intermediate.format: 10 rounds of alternating max-effort intervals

scaling.easier: 45s rest per round; step burpees; reduce to 7 rounds
scaling.harder: 12 rounds; hold row output above 350W each interval

intermediate.coaching_cue: Row: legs drive first, arms follow — pulling with your back before your legs extend loses 20% of every stroke.
intermediate.intent: alternating max-effort intervals for high metabolic demand
intermediate.progression_hint: Density finisher — use at end of training week; progress to 12 rounds when row output stays above 300W for all intervals

intermediate.title: 20-20-20 Sprint Complex
intermediate.format: 4 rounds of 3-movement sprint complex with full rest

scaling.easier: Rower instead of bike; step-overs; reduce to 3 rounds
scaling.harder: 5 rounds; target minimum 10 box jump-overs per 20s

intermediate.coaching_cue: The 20s rest is not passive — controlled breathing only. Flopping on the floor costs the next round.
intermediate.intent: CNS-demanding sprint complex with compressed recovery
intermediate.progression_hint: High-intensity capstone session; add a 5th round only when rounds 1–4 produce equal bike output and box jump-over counts

intermediate.title: Run and Pull Chipper
intermediate.format: For time — 25-min cap

scaling.easier: 30-rep chipper: 200m run / 20 pull-ups / 15 push press / 10 deadlifts
scaling.harder: Scale up load 10%; target under 18 min

intermediate.coaching_cue: Break pull-ups into small sets from rep one — 5s of rest between sets costs nothing; sets of 1 after failure costs everything.
intermediate.intent: high-volume chipper to test aerobic and strength endurance
intermediate.progression_hint: Benchmark chipper — sub-20 min signals graduation to mixed-subtype programming; retest after 4-week block

beginner.title: First Zone 2 Run — 25 Min

structure.rule: Maintain a pace where you can speak in full sentences without pausing to breathe

scaling.easier: Walk the full 25 min; introduce 30s jogs every 3 min once breathing stays easy
scaling.harder: Extend to 35 min at same Zone 2 effort; add 5 min per week

beginner.coaching_cue: If you have to open your mouth to breathe, you are already out of zone 2 — slow down.
beginner.intent: establish aerobic base through first continuous Zone 2 effort
beginner.progression_hint: Week 1 aerobic primer — repeat until nasal breathing holds for full 25 min, then advance to z2-b-02

beginner.title: Flat Bike Hold
beginner.format: Continuous stationary bike at fixed resistance

structure.rule: If cadence drops below 70 RPM, reduce resistance instead of grinding

scaling.easier: Reduce to 15-min Zone 2 block; extend by 5 min per session over 4 weeks
scaling.harder: Extend to 45 min; add light hill walking to elevate Zone 2 challenge

beginner.coaching_cue: Cadence over resistance — spinning at 85 RPM is aerobic work; grinding at 60 RPM is not.
beginner.intent: build uninterrupted Zone 2 duration on low-impact modality
beginner.progression_hint: Add 5 min each session until 45 min is sustainable; gateway to z2-b-04 cycling block

beginner.title: Easy Row Session

focus_cues: Legs drive first — feel the hamstrings load before the arms begin to pull
Full slide on recovery — don't rush the return

scaling.easier: 15 min with a 30s standing rest every 5 min; progress to continuous over 2 weeks
scaling.harder: Increase to 35 min steady; focus on holding heart rate in lower half of Zone 2

beginner.coaching_cue: At zone 2 pace, your catch angle and finish position should be clean every stroke — if they're not, you've gone too fast.
beginner.intent: aerobic base via steady-state rowing at conversational pace
beginner.progression_hint: Use as Zone 2 variety in week 2-3; advance to z2-i-02 when 30 min continuous row feels controlled

beginner.title: Walk-to-Jog Builder
beginner.format: Progressive run/walk intervals building toward continuous jog

structure.rule: Jog pace must allow nasal breathing throughout — mouth breathing = too fast

scaling.easier: Cycle at easy pace (flat ground); reduce to 20 min
scaling.harder: Extend to 50 min; add 3 × 5-min moderate climbs within ride

beginner.coaching_cue: Each jog interval ends before you are breathing hard — that restraint is exactly what builds your aerobic base.
beginner.intent: low-impact aerobic development through extended cycling
beginner.progression_hint: Cycling builds volume without joint stress — extend by 5 min per session; pairs with z2-b-01 run sessions in same week

beginner.title: Incline Walk
beginner.format: Sustained incline treadmill walk at fixed pace

structure.hr_check: every 10 min — reduce incline 1% if HR exceeds 70% max

scaling.easier: Reduce to 3 blocks; skip the final brisk block
scaling.harder: 5 blocks; extend each zone 2 segment to 8 min

beginner.coaching_cue: Hold the handrails only for balance, not for support — offloading your bodyweight removes the aerobic stimulus entirely.
beginner.intent: modality mixing to build aerobic breadth across effort zones
beginner.progression_hint: Prepares cardiovascular system for mixed-format training; use when single-modality sessions feel stale

beginner.title: Nasal Breathing Run
beginner.format: Continuous run gated by breathing quality

structure.rule: Nose-breathe exclusively — the moment you need to open your mouth, reduce pace until nasal breathing is restored
structure.expected_pace: likely 30–90s per km slower than normal easy pace

scaling.easier: 10-min swim; rest every 2 laps; kick board for leg laps
scaling.harder: 35-min swim; alternate freestyle and backstroke every 50m

beginner.coaching_cue: This will feel embarrassingly slow the first time — that gap between your current pace and your aerobic capacity is exactly what you're here to close.
beginner.intent: aerobic capacity via low-impact swim — full-body demand
beginner.progression_hint: Swim sessions accelerate recovery while building aerobic base; advance to 30 min when 20 min is completed without rest

beginner.title: 3-Phase Aerobic Build
beginner.format: Single continuous session divided into 3 ascending RPE thirds

structure.modality: Run, bike, or row — your choice, keep it consistent

equipment: none, stationary bike, or rowing ergometer

scaling.easier: Use flat trail; reduce to 25 min; pause every 10 min
scaling.harder: Increase to 50 min; include 2 moderate hill segments

beginner.coaching_cue: Phase 3 at 5/10 RPE should still allow full sentences — if you're cutting words, dial it back.
beginner.intent: natural terrain aerobic development with variable gradient
beginner.progression_hint: Trail walking builds proprioception and aerobic base simultaneously; progress to z2-b-01 jogging format after 4 weeks

beginner.title: Row–Walk Alternation
beginner.format: Cross-modality aerobic session — alternating rowing erg and brisk walk

scaling.easier: Reduce run-walk ratio to 1:2 (1 min jog / 2 min walk)
scaling.harder: Extend total time to 40 min; progress toward continuous run

beginner.coaching_cue: The walk after rowing lets your HR settle while staying aerobically active — don't sit down between blocks.
beginner.intent: run-walk protocol to develop continuous aerobic capacity
beginner.progression_hint: Classic Galloway bridge — progress run-walk ratio from 1:1 toward continuous running over 4-6 weeks

beginner.title: Steady Bike — Perceived Effort Lock
beginner.format: Continuous bike session with mid-session RPE self-assessment

check_points.action: Speak 10 words aloud — adjust resistance if breathless
Speak 10 words aloud — if still easy, increase cadence by 5 RPM

structure.rule: No HR monitor required — effort perception is the training tool here

scaling.easier: Reduce to 25 min; skip the tempo block
scaling.harder: Extend Zone 2 to 30 min; increase tempo block to 10 min

beginner.coaching_cue: Talking aloud to yourself is not optional here — it's the only accurate zone 2 gauge you have without a heart rate monitor.
beginner.intent: aerobic volume with brief tempo exposure for cardiac development
beginner.progression_hint: Introduces tempo pacing before full threshold work; advance tempo block to 10 min before entering z2-i tier

beginner.title: Long Walk with Intention
beginner.format: Power walk — structured pacing with arm drive

structure.speed: 5–6 km/h on flat or 4–5 km/h on 4% incline
technique_cues: Strong arm drive — elbows at 90°, forward-back motion
Heel strike to toe push-off — full stride length

scaling.easier: 3 stations only; reduce to 8 min per station
scaling.harder: 5 stations; 15 min each; choose 5 different cardio modalities

beginner.coaching_cue: A power walk at 6 km/h with full arm drive is a legitimate aerobic training session — do not underestimate it.
beginner.intent: cross-training aerobic session across multiple modalities
beginner.progression_hint: Rotation format prevents adaptation plateau; use as weekly variety session alongside primary Zone 2 modality

intermediate.title: 45-Minute HR Discipline Run
intermediate.format: Continuous run with strict HR ceiling

structure.protocol: Slow or walk immediately whenever HR exceeds ceiling — resume running once HR drops back below
structure.note: Expect to walk on hills and in minutes 30–40 when fatigue accumulates — this is correct behaviour, not failure

scaling.easier: Reduce to 45 min; drop MAF heart rate by 5 bpm
scaling.harder: 70-min MAF run; log pace every 10 min to track aerobic development

intermediate.coaching_cue: The walk breaks are the training — you are teaching your body to stay aerobic, not to survive anaerobically.
intermediate.intent: build sustained aerobic output at MAF heart rate
intermediate.progression_hint: Core long-run session — log pace every 10 min; when drift is under 15 sec/km over 60 min, extend to 75 min

intermediate.title: 60-Minute Cadence Bike
intermediate.format: Structured cadence-progressive stationary bike

structure.rule: Reduce resistance to maintain cadence target — do not drop cadence to manage load

scaling.easier: Reduce ride to 60 min; lower watt target by 10%
scaling.harder: 100-min ride; include 3 × 10-min aerobic intervals at Zone 2 ceiling

intermediate.coaching_cue: Higher cadence at the same HR means your aerobic system is running more efficiently — that is the adaptation you are chasing.
intermediate.intent: high-volume aerobic work via extended cycling
intermediate.progression_hint: Weekly long ride — extend by 10 min per week toward 90 min; pairs with a 30-min Zone 2 run later in the same week

intermediate.title: Steady Row — Split Lock
intermediate.format: Continuous rowing erg at fixed split target

structure.split_target: Set a pace you can hold for 40 min — typically 15–25s per 500m slower than your 2k pace
structure.hr_check: Every 10 min — if HR climbs above 75% max, add 5s to your split

scaling.easier: 4 × 15 min; 3 min active rest
scaling.harder: 6 × 15 min; reduce rest to 90s; record HR at end of each block

intermediate.coaching_cue: A split you can hold means you finish feeling like you could do 10 more minutes — if you feel relieved at the end, you went too hard.
intermediate.intent: aerobic interval blocks to raise lactate threshold floor
intermediate.progression_hint: Structured Zone 2 intervals build base faster than continuous effort — advance to 6 × 15 min when HR stabilises in lower Zone 2 by minute 10

intermediate.title: Negative Split Run
intermediate.format: Single continuous run divided into slower-first / faster-second halves

structure.rule: Half 2 pace must still allow full sentences — if it doesn't, you went too fast in the second half

scaling.easier: 2 rounds only; walk recovery between rounds
scaling.harder: 4 rounds; reduce walk recovery to 3 min

intermediate.coaching_cue: Most athletes run their easy runs positive-split without realising — this session corrects that pattern permanently.
intermediate.intent: run-walk pyramid to extend aerobic endurance range
intermediate.progression_hint: Progressive overload model — add one round per week; graduate to continuous 60-min run when 3 rounds feel comfortable

intermediate.title: Aerobic Cross-Train Block
intermediate.format: Consecutive dual-modality session with immediate transitions

structure.note: HR will spike briefly on each transition — wait 90s for it to restabilise before adjusting effort

scaling.easier: Reduce to 40 min total; slow all segments by 15 sec/km
scaling.harder: 70-min total; tighten threshold segment pacing by 5 sec/km

intermediate.coaching_cue: Switching modality mid-session taxes your aerobic system in a different pattern — the brief HR spike is not a failure of pacing.
intermediate.intent: aerobic volume with embedded tempo work for cardiac output
intermediate.progression_hint: Threshold embedded in Zone 2 session mirrors race-pace demands; progress tempo segment by 2 min per block cycle

intermediate.title: MAF Heart Rate Long Run
intermediate.format: Continuous run at MAF heart rate ceiling (180 − age)

structure.hr_ceiling: 180 minus your age in beats per minute
structure.protocol: Never exceed ceiling — slow to a walk if needed
structure.example: Age 30 → ceiling 150 bpm; age 40 → ceiling 140 bpm
structure.progression_signal: After 4 weeks, you should be running faster at the same HR ceiling — that is the measurable adaptation

scaling.easier: Drop MAF target by 10 bpm; run/walk intervals
scaling.harder: 90-min MAF run; log each 10-min split for pace drift analysis

intermediate.coaching_cue: The MAF method works only if you respect the ceiling every single session — one anaerobic breach resets the signal.
intermediate.intent: MAF protocol long run for aerobic efficiency development
intermediate.progression_hint: Log pace splits every 10 min — improvement in pace at same HR over 8 weeks is the primary adaptation marker

intermediate.title: Incline Run Protocol
intermediate.format: Structured treadmill run with programmed grade changes

structure.rule: Reduce speed on each grade increase to keep HR in zone 2 — the grade is the load variable, not the speed

scaling.easier: 60-min ride; reduce ladder top to 90 min effort
scaling.harder: Full 90-min ride; hold power within 5% throughout

intermediate.coaching_cue: Uphill zone 2 builds more aerobic strength per minute than flat zone 2 — the slower pace is the point, not the problem.
intermediate.intent: extended cycling volume to build fat-oxidation capacity
intermediate.progression_hint: Longest aerobic session in the intermediate block — completing 90 min at stable HR signals readiness for mixed-modality endurance work

intermediate.title: Cardiac Output Builder
intermediate.format: 60-minute continuous low-intensity session targeting stroke volume adaptation

structure.hr_target: 130–145 bpm (adjust to age — target is consistent, not high)
structure.modality: Any single modality: run, bike, row, or walk
structure.rule: Stay in the target HR band for the full 60 min — neither below (too easy to adapt) nor above (too hard to sustain)
structure.note: 60-minute sessions at this HR are the primary stimulus for left ventricular chamber expansion

scaling.easier: 3 modalities; reduce each to 15 min
scaling.harder: 5 modalities; increase to 20 min each (100-min session)

intermediate.coaching_cue: 60 minutes at a consistent HR is not a test of willpower — it is the minimum duration for a cardiac output adaptation to occur.
intermediate.intent: cross-modality endurance to prevent adaptation and boost overall aerobic capacity
intermediate.progression_hint: Rotate modality order each session to avoid skill-specific fatigue; progress each segment to 20 min before adding a 5th modality

intermediate.title: Surge-and-Settle Bike
intermediate.format: Continuous bike with repeated HR-spike recovery cycles

main_set.description: 4 × 2-min moderate surge (RPE 6/10) followed by return to zone 2 (RPE 4/10) — hold zone 2 until HR fully settles before next surge
main_set.recovery_target: HR back below 70% max before next surge — typically 5–8 min

scaling.easier: Reduce base to 20 min; 1 surge block only
scaling.harder: 45-min base + 4 surge blocks; target 10-bpm surge above Zone 2 ceiling

intermediate.coaching_cue: The quality of this session is measured by how fast your HR returns to zone 2 after each surge — track that number across weeks.
intermediate.intent: Zone 2 base with surge blocks to stress cardiac recovery
intermediate.progression_hint: Surge-recovery pattern trains the heart to return to Zone 2 quickly — a key predictor of aerobic fitness; add one surge block per month

intermediate.title: Fasted Long Aerobic
intermediate.format: 60-minute zone 2 session performed in a fasted state (morning, before eating)

structure.timing: Perform first thing in the morning before any food — water only
structure.modality: Run, walk, or bike at RPE 3–4/10
structure.hr_ceiling: 65% max HR — lower than normal because fasted state elevates perceived effort
structure.rule: If RPE rises above 5/10 at any point, slow down — fasted aerobic work is substrate training, not intensity training

scaling.easier: 40-min endurance brick; skip strength finisher
scaling.harder: 60-min bike + 20-min run + 3 × 8 heavy compound strength finisher

intermediate.coaching_cue: Fasted zone 2 trains your body to oxidise fat at low intensities — the adaptation is metabolic, not cardiovascular, and it takes 6–8 weeks to appear.
intermediate.intent: endurance brick combining aerobic capacity and strength retention
intermediate.progression_hint: Prepares the body for mixed-subtype weeks — use as a weekly anchor session; advance to mix-i-07 triathlon brick when 50-min bike + 10-min run feels easy

beginner.title: Cardio + Core Circuit
beginner.format: 3 rounds: 2 min jog / 6 exercises / 2 min rest

blocks.cardio: 2 min light jog or march in place

scaling.easier: Step instead of jog; all reps reduced by 2
scaling.harder: Add 2 reps per set; reduce rest to 90s

beginner.coaching_cue: Keep moving between exercises; rest only after the full block.
beginner.intent: simultaneous aerobic and strength stimulus via circuit rotation
beginner.progression_hint: Entry mixed session — repeat until all 3 rounds complete with full rep counts; advance to mix-b-02 when rest between rounds feels unnecessary

beginner.title: Dumbbell + Walk Intervals

scaling.easier: 2 rounds; reduce to 6 reps each
scaling.harder: 5 rounds; increase DB weight

beginner.coaching_cue: Walk at a pace where talking is slightly effortful — Zone 2 effort.
beginner.intent: aerobic base building paired with compound strength movement
beginner.progression_hint: Walk-strength pairing is the safest hybrid entry point; progress walk pace to brisk jog over 4 weeks before advancing to mix-b-07

beginner.title: Jump + Lift Superset
beginner.format: 3 rounds: jump exercise paired with lift (A/B superset)

scaling.easier: Remove jump; replace with step-out jacks
scaling.harder: Add weighted vest; 4 rounds

beginner.coaching_cue: Explode up on the step; control the descent.
beginner.intent: lower-body power paired with compound pressing for concurrent stimulus
beginner.progression_hint: Superset format builds work capacity efficiency; advance to mix-b-09 when both supersets complete with zero form breakdown

beginner.title: Rowing + Band Strength

scaling.easier: 3 rounds; 2 min row
scaling.harder: Increase row pace to 24 spm; heavier band

beginner.coaching_cue: Drive through the legs first, then lean back and pull — sequence matters.
beginner.intent: aerobic endurance via rowing paired with upper-body pulling volume
beginner.progression_hint: Rowing sessions develop posterior chain and aerobic base simultaneously; increase row pace to 24 spm when 5 rounds feel controlled

beginner.title: Bike + Bodyweight Burn
beginner.format: EMOM 24 min: odd min bike, even min bodyweight

scaling.easier: Reduce sprint to 25s; 8 squats / 4 push-ups
scaling.harder: 45s sprint; 12 squats / 8 push-ups / 8 sit-ups

beginner.coaching_cue: On bike minutes, push hard; bodyweight minutes are active recovery.
beginner.intent: EMOM structure to develop cardio-strength alternation capacity
beginner.progression_hint: EMOM discipline — if rest falls below 10s on any minute, reduce reps immediately; advance to mix-i-05 when 24 min completes with 15+ sec consistently

beginner.title: Core + Cardio Flow

scaling.easier: March instead of high knees; 3 rounds
scaling.harder: Add 30s mountain climbers after core block

beginner.coaching_cue: Breathe out on exertion; never hold your breath on core work.
beginner.intent: metabolic conditioning via cardio burst and deep core stability pairing
beginner.progression_hint: Core stability under cardiovascular fatigue is the key adaptation; advance when bird dog and dead bug maintain form through round 4

beginner.title: Kettlebell + Jog Repeats

scaling.easier: 3 rounds; reduce to 8 KB swings
scaling.harder: Increase KB weight; run at moderate pace

beginner.coaching_cue: Hinge at the hip for swings — it's not a squat.
beginner.intent: aerobic endurance fused with KB strength-endurance across five rounds
beginner.progression_hint: Longest beginner mixed session — completing 5 rounds sub-35 min signals readiness for mix-i-01 tempo run complex

beginner.title: Stair + Upper Body
beginner.format: 3 rounds: 3 min stair climb / 5 upper-body exercises

blocks.cardio: 3 min stair climber or step-ups on box

scaling.easier: 2 rounds; bodyweight rows instead of DB flies
scaling.harder: 4 rounds; increase DB weight

beginner.coaching_cue: Keep elbows slightly soft on lateral raises — avoid shrugging.
beginner.intent: upper-body isolation volume on an aerobic foundation
beginner.progression_hint: Stair or step cardio elevates heart rate before isolation work — increases metabolic cost of lifting; progress to 4 rounds when upper-body form holds

beginner.title: Full-Body Tabata Finisher

scaling.easier: Skip Tabata finisher; do 2 sets in part 1
scaling.harder: Add mountain climbers as 3rd Tabata exercise

beginner.coaching_cue: Start the Tabata with form — fatigue compounds so dial technique in early.
beginner.intent: strength base followed by high-intensity metabolic finisher
beginner.progression_hint: Strength-then-HIIT sequencing mimics Hyrox event demands; advance to mix-i-08 density blocks when Tabata finisher is completed at consistent rep counts

beginner.title: Zone 2 + Mobility Blend

blocks.cardio: 5 min zone 2 effort — walk/cycle/swim at conversational pace

scaling.easier: 2 rounds (20 min)
scaling.harder: 6 rounds (60 min)

beginner.coaching_cue: Mobility work is earned — use the elevated heart rate to access range of motion.
beginner.intent: aerobic base recovery session with active mobility integration
beginner.progression_hint: Low-intensity recovery session — schedule 48h after HIIT or heavy days; progress to 6 rounds as aerobic capacity improves

intermediate.title: Tempo Run + Olympic Lift Complex
intermediate.format: 5 rounds: 800m tempo / 3-movement barbell complex

blocks.note: Do not set bar down within complex

scaling.easier: 4 rounds; 400m run; reduce weight 20%
scaling.harder: 6 rounds; 1000m; increase weight 10%

intermediate.coaching_cue: Drive through your legs on the clean — don't muscle it up.
intermediate.intent: tempo run fused with barbell complex for concurrent strength-endurance
intermediate.progression_hint: Olympic lifting under cardiovascular fatigue is a direct Hyrox/hybrid sport skill; advance to 6 rounds when complex maintains bar speed through round 5

intermediate.title: Heavy Dumbbell + Assault Bike Intervals
intermediate.format: 6 rounds: 90s bike / 6 DB exercises

scaling.easier: 4 rounds; 60s bike
scaling.harder: Increase DB weight; 2 min bike

intermediate.coaching_cue: The assault bike is metabolic debt — the strength work after is the interest payment.
intermediate.intent: maximal metabolic output via bike sprint and heavy DB compound pairing
intermediate.progression_hint: Assault bike pre-fatigues the system before loaded work — mimics competition demands; increase DB weight when form holds through all 6 rounds

intermediate.title: Barbell Strength + Running Intervals
intermediate.format: 4 rounds: 400m run / 3 barbell lifts

blocks.note: Heavy working weight — not a warm-up

scaling.easier: 3 rounds; 75% of normal working weight
scaling.harder: 5 rounds; 90% working weight

intermediate.coaching_cue: You are pre-fatigued by the run — brace harder before each lift.
intermediate.intent: maintain strength output under aerobic pre-fatigue
intermediate.progression_hint: Pre-fatigued lifting is a key adaptation for hybrid athletes; progress to 5 rounds at 90% working weight when form is consistent across all 4 rounds

intermediate.title: KB Complex + Rower Pyramid
intermediate.format: Row pyramid 250/500/750/500/250m with KB complex between each

between_each.note: One pass through complex between each row segment

scaling.easier: 250/500/250 pyramid; lighter KB

intermediate.coaching_cue: Stay consistent on row splits — go out too hot and you'll blow up on the 750.
intermediate.intent: rowing pyramid fused with KB complex for full-body endurance
intermediate.progression_hint: Pyramid structure tests pacing discipline; advance to full 7-segment pyramid when 5-segment is completed with even KB form throughout

intermediate.title: EMOM 30: Cardio / Strength / Core Rotation
intermediate.format: EMOM 30 min — minute 1 cardio, minute 2 strength, minute 3 core, repeat

scaling.easier: 20 min EMOM (reduce to 7 rounds)
scaling.harder: Add 2 reps per set each round (progressive overload)

intermediate.coaching_cue: Use the first few minutes to gauge effort — find the pace you can sustain for 30 minutes.
intermediate.intent: concurrent cardio-strength-core EMOM to maximise training density
intermediate.progression_hint: 30-min EMOM is a significant volume marker; advance rep counts by 1 per exercise per month when all minutes maintain 15+ sec rest

intermediate.title: Strongman Cardio Circuit
intermediate.format: 5 rounds: 200m farmer carry + 3 strongman movements

scaling.easier: 3 rounds; 100m farmer carry
scaling.harder: Increase all weights 10%; reduce rest to 90s

intermediate.coaching_cue: Grip is the limiting factor — chalk up and keep shoulders packed.
intermediate.intent: strongman conditioning for grip, posterior chain, and cardiovascular capacity
intermediate.progression_hint: Strongman modalities transfer directly to functional fitness competition; increase all weights 5% when 5 rounds complete with under 90s rest

intermediate.title: Triathlon-Style Brick
intermediate.format: 20 min bike → 5 min run → 3 sets strength

scaling.easier: 10 min bike; 2 min run; 2 sets
scaling.harder: 30 min bike; 10 min run; add weight to lifts

intermediate.coaching_cue: Brick legs are real — expect your run to feel heavy for the first 90 seconds.
intermediate.intent: triathlon-style brick to develop multi-sport aerobic and strength capacity
intermediate.progression_hint: Brick training eliminates the transition shock between modalities; extend bike to 30 min and run to 10 min before adding strength finisher load

intermediate.title: Density Block Training
intermediate.format: 3 blocks × 7 min AMRAP: block 1 lower, block 2 upper, block 3 cardio

scaling.easier: 5 min AMRAPs; reduce weight
scaling.harder: 10 min AMRAPs; increase weight

intermediate.coaching_cue: Track your rounds each block — beat your score next session.
intermediate.intent: density block training for total-body volume accumulation
intermediate.progression_hint: Track rounds per block each session — a 10% improvement in any block over 4 weeks indicates readiness to increase load or block duration

intermediate.title: Power Snatch + Ski Erg Intervals
intermediate.format: 6 rounds: 250m ski erg / 5 power snatches

scaling.easier: 4 rounds; dumbbell hang snatch substitute
scaling.harder: 8 rounds; increase snatch weight

intermediate.coaching_cue: Pull the bar close — wide arc means you're using arms, not hips.
intermediate.intent: Olympic lifting technique under aerobic fatigue via ski erg pairing
intermediate.progression_hint: Snatch technique degrades under fatigue before any other lift — use this session to identify technique breakdown points; add 2 rounds when form holds through 6

intermediate.title: Zone 2 + Strength Superset
intermediate.format: 60 min alternating: 8 min Z2 / 4 min heavy superset × 5

blocks.cardio: 8 min zone 2 — bike or treadmill, 60-70% HRmax

scaling.easier: 3 rounds (36 min); bodyweight pull-up
scaling.harder: Add 5% load each round; 6 rounds

intermediate.coaching_cue: Zone 2 is your aerobic base — protect it by staying disciplined on intensity.
intermediate.intent: Zone 2 aerobic base alternated with heavy compound strength for dual adaptation
intermediate.progression_hint: Concurrent training at elite level — completing 5 rounds without HR exceeding Zone 2 ceiling during cardio blocks signals strong aerobic-strength integration

beginner.title: 3×5 Linear Progression

structure.progression: Add 5 lb per session when all reps are completed

scaling.easier: Use empty bar or PVC to learn movement pattern
scaling.harder: Add 2.5 lb per exercise per session instead of 5 lb

beginner.coaching_cue: Brace your belly before you unrack — tension is protection.
beginner.intent: introduce linear progression on the three primary barbell lifts
beginner.progression_hint: The foundational beginner strength protocol — add weight every session until stalls occur; graduate to hvy-b-07 full-body day when squat exceeds 1× bodyweight

beginner.title: Dumbbell Heavy Day

scaling.easier: Start with a weight you can do 12 reps with; add weight when 8 reps feel easy
scaling.harder: Increase to 4 sets; add slow eccentric (3-count down)

beginner.coaching_cue: Choose a weight where the last 2 reps are hard but form stays crisp.
beginner.intent: full-body compound strength via dumbbell push-pull-hinge-squat pattern
beginner.progression_hint: DB strength is the gateway before barbell loading; progress to hvy-b-01 barbell protocol when all 4 movements complete 3×8 with controlled tempo

beginner.title: Trap Bar Pull Day
beginner.format: Trap bar deadlift heavy + accessory rows and carries

scaling.easier: DB deadlift substitute; reduce to 3 sets
scaling.harder: Add deficit (stand on plates) for trap bar sets

beginner.coaching_cue: Push the floor away — it's a leg press, not a back pull.
beginner.intent: posterior chain development via trap bar deadlift and loaded carry
beginner.progression_hint: Trap bar reduces technical demand while building pulling strength; transition to conventional barbell deadlift in hvy-b-01 when trap bar exceeds 1.5× bodyweight

beginner.title: Push Day Fundamentals

exercises.note: Focus on bar path and leg drive

scaling.easier: Incline DB press instead of bench; knee push-up
scaling.harder: Increase weight 5 lb each session; add band-resisted push-up

beginner.coaching_cue: Retract and depress your scapulae before every pressing rep.
beginner.intent: horizontal and vertical pressing strength via three-movement push day
beginner.progression_hint: Push day foundation — advance bench press load by 2.5 kg per session; pair with hvy-b-05 pull day in same training week

beginner.title: Pull Day Fundamentals

scaling.easier: DB row only; band pull-apart instead of face pull
scaling.harder: Replace lat pulldown with weighted pull-up

beginner.coaching_cue: Pull to your sternum — not your chin — for full lat engagement.
beginner.intent: upper-body pulling strength and posterior shoulder resilience
beginner.progression_hint: Pull day complement to hvy-b-04 — face pull volume protects shoulder health under increasing bench loads; advance to weighted pull-up when lat pulldown reaches bodyweight

beginner.title: Leg Day Fundamentals
beginner.format: Squat + hip hinge + single-leg, 3 sets each

scaling.easier: Goblet squat; DB RDL; reverse lunge instead of Bulgarian
scaling.harder: Add 5 lb per session; tempo squat (3-0-1)

beginner.coaching_cue: Keep your chest up in the squat — think tall spine, not forward lean.
beginner.intent: lower-body strength across squat, hinge, and single-leg patterns
beginner.progression_hint: Complete leg day — Bulgarian split squat exposes bilateral strength imbalances early; correct before advancing loads; pairs with hvy-b-04 and hvy-b-05 in a 3-day split

beginner.title: Full-Body Heavy Day

scaling.easier: Reduce to 3 exercises; 2 sets each
scaling.harder: Work up to heavy triple on each lift

beginner.coaching_cue: Full-body days require more warm-up time — budget 10 min before working sets.
beginner.intent: full-body barbell strength accumulation across five compound lifts
beginner.progression_hint: Total-body strength day — use when training frequency is 2x per week; progress to 3-day push/pull/legs split (hvy-b-04/05/06) when schedule allows

beginner.title: 5-3-1 Introduction Week
beginner.format: Week 1 of 5-3-1: 3 sets (5/5/5+) on two main lifts

scaling.easier: Calculate training max at 80% of 1RM instead of 90%
scaling.harder: Run the program as written — resist the urge to go heavier

beginner.coaching_cue: Leave reps in the tank on the first two sets — it's a warm-up, not a max effort.
beginner.intent: introduce percentage-based loading via 5-3-1 week one protocol
beginner.progression_hint: First exposure to auto-regulated programming — calculate training max at 90% of tested 1RM; cycle through weeks 1-3 before deload; builds toward hvy-i-01 max effort work

beginner.title: Kettlebell Strength Day

scaling.easier: Single KB for all movements; reduce to 3 sets
scaling.harder: Heavier bell; add Turkish get-up 3 per side as finisher

beginner.coaching_cue: The bent press is a slow grind — do not rush; find the groove.
beginner.intent: KB-specific strength day targeting press, squat, hinge, and lateral patterns
beginner.progression_hint: KB strength builds grip and unilateral stability before barbell loading; advance to double KB work in hvy-i tier when all 4 sets complete with strict form

beginner.title: Pause Rep Day

exercises.exercise: Pause back squat (2s pause at bottom)
Pause bench press (2s pause on chest)
Pause deadlift (2s pause just below knee)

scaling.easier: 1s pause; reduce weight to 75%
scaling.harder: 3s pause; work up to normal working weight

beginner.coaching_cue: Pause reps build positional strength — stay braced during the full pause.
beginner.intent: positional strength development via paused reps on three primary lifts
beginner.progression_hint: Pause work identifies and fixes positional weaknesses — programme once every 3 weeks alongside regular strength days; directly feeds into hvy-i-01 max effort protocols

intermediate.title: Max Effort Lower
intermediate.format: Work up to daily max on squat or deadlift, then back-off sets

working_sets.note: Work to daily max (not all-time max — RPE 9)

scaling.easier: Cap at 90% of 1RM; reduce back-off to 2 sets
scaling.harder: True 1RM attempt once per month — not weekly

intermediate.coaching_cue: Daily max is the heaviest you can lift with perfect form today — judge by bar speed.
intermediate.intent: max effort lower body to develop peak force output
intermediate.progression_hint: Core conjugate session — rotate squat and deadlift weekly; daily max should not exceed RPE 9; true 1RM testing reserved for competition or monthly testing day

intermediate.title: Max Effort Upper
intermediate.format: Work up to daily max on bench or press, then back-off sets

structure.main_lift: Bench press (rotate with overhead press weekly)

scaling.easier: 3-rep max instead of 1-rep max
scaling.harder: Board press variation to overload lockout

intermediate.coaching_cue: Set your back arch before unracking — don't try to arch after you've taken the bar.
intermediate.intent: max effort upper body to build absolute pressing strength
intermediate.progression_hint: Pairs with hvy-i-01 in a two-day max effort split; rotate bench and OHP weekly; back-off volume accumulates hypertrophy under the strength stimulus

intermediate.title: Dynamic Effort Lower
intermediate.format: 8×2 speed squats at 60% + 3×5 heavy accessory

main_lift.note: Max intent on every rep — explode up

scaling.easier: 60-65% with bands for accommodating resistance
scaling.harder: Add chains; increase to 10×2

intermediate.coaching_cue: Bar speed IS the goal — think about pushing the earth away as fast as possible.
intermediate.intent: speed-strength development via submaximal squats with max intent
intermediate.progression_hint: Dynamic effort squat builds bar speed that transfers to heavier max effort days; run this 72h before or after hvy-i-01 to avoid CNS overlap

intermediate.title: Dynamic Effort Upper
intermediate.format: 9×3 speed bench at 50% + 3×6 heavy row

scaling.easier: 6×3; slightly higher weight (55%)
scaling.harder: Use bands for accommodating resistance

intermediate.coaching_cue: The touch on your chest should be controlled — don't bounce.
intermediate.intent: speed-strength development via submaximal bench with explosive concentric
intermediate.progression_hint: Dynamic effort upper pairs with hvy-i-02 max effort bench; 9×3 at 50% with max intent produces greater rate of force development than grinding heavy singles

intermediate.title: Conjugate Deadlift Day
intermediate.format: Heavy Romanian deadlift wave + speed conventional

accessory.exercise: Glute ham raise or Nordic curl

scaling.easier: Reduce top set to 85%; 4 speed sets
scaling.harder: Add bands to speed sets

intermediate.coaching_cue: Keep the bar close — it should drag your shins on the way up.
intermediate.intent: posterior chain overload via RDL wave loading plus speed conventional pulls
intermediate.progression_hint: Wave loading on RDL peaks hamstring tension progressively — top set at 90% followed by speed work cements neural efficiency; feeds directly into hvy-i-01 deadlift max effort

intermediate.title: Heavy Front Squat Day
intermediate.format: Work up to 5RM front squat + 3×5 back squat back-off

main_lift.note: Work up to 5-rep max in 4-5 sets

scaling.easier: Goblet squat as front squat substitute
scaling.harder: 3RM front squat; add pause at bottom

intermediate.coaching_cue: Elbows HIGH — if they drop, you'll tip forward and dump the bar.
intermediate.intent: front squat strength for quad dominance and upper back loading capacity
intermediate.progression_hint: Front squat 5RM is a reliable indicator of clean receiving position strength; when 5RM exceeds 80% of back squat 1RM, Olympic lifting technique will improve markedly

intermediate.title: Heavy Push-Pull Superset Day
intermediate.format: 4 heavy supersets: bench paired with row, press paired with pull-up

scaling.easier: Reduce to 3 sets per superset; lighter weight
scaling.harder: Add 5 lb each superset across the 4 sets (ascending)

intermediate.coaching_cue: Supersets shorten total time without sacrificing load — keep transition under 15 seconds.
intermediate.intent: antagonist superset pairing for maximum pressing and pulling volume efficiency
intermediate.progression_hint: Push-pull superset allows higher frequency without extended session length; track both lifts independently — imbalance over 20% between bench and row signals a priority shift

intermediate.title: Volume Wave Loading
intermediate.format: Wave loading: sets of 6-4-2 × 2 waves on squat

structure.note: Start wave 2 slightly heavier than wave 1 — potentiation effect

scaling.easier: One wave only; reduce loads 10%
scaling.harder: 3 waves; increase load 3-5% per wave

intermediate.coaching_cue: Wave 2 should feel lighter than wave 1 at the same weight — that's post-activation potentiation working.
intermediate.intent: wave loading to exploit post-activation potentiation on back squat
intermediate.progression_hint: Two waves at escalating load teach the nervous system to recruit maximally — wave 2 should consistently outperform wave 1 at the same percentages; if not, fatigue is too high

intermediate.title: Deadlift Variation Day
intermediate.format: 3 deadlift variations: sumo / conventional / trap bar

scaling.easier: Choose one variation only; 3 sets
scaling.harder: Add a 4th variation: deficit deadlift

intermediate.coaching_cue: Sumo demands hip mobility — warm up your hip flexors before loading.
intermediate.intent: multi-variation deadlift day to build positional strength across stances
intermediate.progression_hint: Sumo exposes hip mobility limits; conventional builds raw pulling strength; trap bar reduces spinal load — weakest variation identifies the priority for the next training block

intermediate.title: Heavy Accessory Block
intermediate.format: 5 accessory lifts × 4 sets × 6 reps — all heavy

scaling.easier: 3 sets each; reduce weight to 3 reps shy of failure
scaling.harder: Rest-pause technique: hit reps, rest 20s, squeeze out 2-3 more

intermediate.coaching_cue: Accessory work is where strength is built — don't treat it as second-class.
intermediate.intent: heavy accessory volume to reinforce weak points identified in primary lifts
intermediate.progression_hint: Accessory block runs alongside max effort days — programme once per week; address the lift where you fail first: incline for lockout, chin-up for lat drive off the floor

beginner.title: Box Jump Introduction
beginner.format: 5 sets × 5 box jumps with full rest — technique focus

cues: Step back to reset after each jump
Land softly — absorb with hips and knees

scaling.easier: Step-up practice before first jump; reduce height
scaling.harder: Increase box height; depth drop into jump

beginner.coaching_cue: Jump from a loaded position — dip and swing your arms for maximum power.
beginner.intent: introduce plyometric loading patterns through box jump and broad jump
beginner.progression_hint: First plyometric session — prioritise landing mechanics over height; advance box height only when all 5 sets land silently with full hip absorption

beginner.title: Jumping Lunge Progression

scaling.easier: Bodyweight reverse lunge instead of jumping lunge; remove jump from squat jump
scaling.harder: Add 5 lb vest; increase to 10 reps

beginner.coaching_cue: Land with soft knees — if your landing is loud, your landing is dangerous.
beginner.intent: develop lower-body reactive power through multi-directional jumping
beginner.progression_hint: Multi-plane jump exposure prepares tendons for higher-intensity plyometrics; progress to exp-b-06 depth drops when lateral bound distance is consistent across all 4 rounds

beginner.title: Medicine Ball Power Circuit

scaling.easier: 4 kg ball; 6 reps per exercise
scaling.harder: 8 kg ball; 10 reps; 4 rounds

beginner.coaching_cue: Throw with your whole body — hips first, then torso, then arms.
beginner.intent: rotational and vertical power development via medicine ball throws
beginner.progression_hint: MB throws build triple extension and rotational power simultaneously; increase ball weight by 2 kg when all throw patterns maintain consistent velocity across 3 rounds

beginner.title: Sprint Introduction

structure.rest_note: Walk back to start — full recovery (90-120s)
structure.warmup: 10 min dynamic warm-up: high knees / butt kicks / leg swings / A-skip

scaling.easier: 6 sprints at 75% effort
scaling.harder: 10 sprints at 90% effort; reduce recovery to 60s

beginner.coaching_cue: Drive your arms like pistons — fast arms create fast legs.
beginner.intent: introduce maximum velocity sprint mechanics with full recovery
beginner.progression_hint: Full recovery between sprints is non-negotiable at this stage — quality over quantity; advance to 10 sprints at 90% when all 8 produce consistent technique in final 10m

beginner.title: Burpee Power Circuit

scaling.easier: Standard burpee (no tuck jump); regular push-up
scaling.harder: Add 10s sprint after each round

beginner.coaching_cue: Burpees are full-body power — push the ground away on the jump.
beginner.intent: whole-body explosive output via burpee-jump complex under fatigue
beginner.progression_hint: Burpee-jump pairing builds power endurance; when 5 rounds maintain tuck jump height through round 5, progress to exp-b-10 loaded plyometric finisher

beginner.title: Depth Drop to Jump

exercises.note: Step off box, land, immediately jump up — minimize contact time

scaling.easier: Skip depth drop; practice landing from small hops first
scaling.harder: Increase box height; double depth drop

beginner.coaching_cue: Your contact time with the ground should be milliseconds — think hot coals.
beginner.intent: develop reactive strength via depth drop and ground contact time reduction
beginner.progression_hint: Depth drops are the foundation of shock method training; advance to exp-i-03 full shock protocol only when ground contact is visibly minimal and landings are silent

beginner.title: Power Skipping + Hops

scaling.easier: Focus on form; reduce to 2 rounds
scaling.harder: Add weighted vest; 5 rounds

beginner.coaching_cue: In power skipping, drive your knee to 90° — height comes from leg drive.
beginner.intent: locomotion-based power development through bounding and skipping patterns
beginner.progression_hint: Power skipping and bounding build elastic energy storage in tendons; 4 consistent rounds with full knee drive signals readiness for hurdle work in exp-i-10

beginner.title: Rotational Power Day

scaling.easier: Bodyweight rotation; reduce cable weight
scaling.harder: Add band resistance to MB throws

beginner.coaching_cue: Rotation power starts from the ground up — drive through your feet.
beginner.intent: rotational power and anti-rotation core strength development
beginner.progression_hint: Rotational power is the missing link in most beginners — this session directly improves sports performance and KB swing power; progress cable load when all 4 sets maintain hip initiation

beginner.title: Agility Ladder Introduction

scaling.easier: Walk through pattern first; 2 passes per pattern
scaling.harder: Max speed; add reaction drill at end of each pattern

beginner.coaching_cue: Eyes forward, not on the ladder — feel the pattern, don't look at your feet.
beginner.intent: agility and foot speed development through ladder pattern training
beginner.progression_hint: Ladder work builds neuromuscular coordination before reactive agility drills; when all 6 patterns execute without looking down, progress to exp-i-05 cone and T-drill work

beginner.title: Plyometric Lower-Body Finisher

scaling.easier: Bodyweight only; reduce reps to 4
scaling.harder: Increase box height; add heavy band resistance to squat jumps

beginner.coaching_cue: Every rep should be max intent — never just 'go through the motions' on plyometrics.
beginner.intent: max-effort lower-body plyometric output across four jumping patterns
beginner.progression_hint: Capstone beginner explosive session — single-leg box jump is the readiness marker for intermediate tier; advance to exp-i-01 Olympic lifting foundation when single-leg landing is stable

intermediate.title: Olympic Lifting Foundation
intermediate.format: Power clean + hang snatch complex — 6 × 3+3

scaling.easier: DB hang clean/snatch; reduce load to 65%
scaling.harder: Full clean and full snatch from floor

intermediate.coaching_cue: The bar should feel weightless at the top — that's the double-knee bend doing its job.
intermediate.intent: power clean and hang snatch foundation for Olympic lifting force development
intermediate.progression_hint: First structured Olympic lifting session — bar speed is the quality marker, not load; increase weight only when triple extension is complete on every rep across all 6 sets

intermediate.title: Sprint Velocity Training
intermediate.format: 10 × 20m fly sprints with 30m build-up

structure.rest_note: Walk 4 min between sprints — full CNS recovery

scaling.easier: 8 sprints; 95% effort
scaling.harder: Timed flying 20s; track improvement per session

intermediate.coaching_cue: Max velocity demands max warm-up — do not skip the acceleration drills.
intermediate.intent: maximum velocity sprint development via fly sprint protocol
intermediate.progression_hint: Flying 20s isolate the top-speed phase — the highest-intensity sprint stimulus possible; advance volume to 12 sprints only after 8 weeks of consistent technique at 98% effort

intermediate.title: Shock Method Plyometrics
intermediate.format: Depth drop to max vertical × 8 sets of 3

exercises.exercise: Depth drop to maximum vertical jump
exercises.note: Minimize ground contact — immediate explosive jump

scaling.easier: 20-inch box; standard depth drop without performance tracking
scaling.harder: 32-inch box; add a second box to land on

intermediate.coaching_cue: Your Achilles tendon is the spring — land on your forefoot, not flat-footed.
intermediate.intent: reactive strength development via depth drop shock method
intermediate.progression_hint: Shock method is the most CNS-demanding plyometric stimulus — limit to once per week; advance box height by 2 inches only when amortisation phase is visibly instant

intermediate.title: Clean Pull + Jump Complex
intermediate.format: Contrast training: clean pull paired with box jump × 6 sets

structure.note: Post-activation potentiation: heavy pull primes fast-twitch for box jump

scaling.easier: Trap bar deadlift instead of clean pull; 24-inch box
scaling.harder: Heavy snatch pull; increase box to 36 inches

intermediate.coaching_cue: Box jump after the pull should feel easier — that's PAP in action.
intermediate.intent: contrast training to exploit post-activation potentiation for peak power output
intermediate.progression_hint: PAP contrast sets require 90% clean pull to maximally prime fast-twitch fibres; if box jump height does not improve vs standalone, reduce clean pull load to 85% and retest

intermediate.title: Reactive Agility Course
intermediate.format: 5-cone drill + T-drill + pro agility — 6 sets each

scaling.easier: Walk through patterns; focus on footwork not time
scaling.harder: Add reaction component: coach calls direction at setup

intermediate.coaching_cue: Change of direction speed is 60% deceleration — load your outside leg before you cut.
intermediate.intent: reactive agility development under time pressure via cone drills
intermediate.progression_hint: Timed agility drills build sport-specific change-of-direction speed; when 5-10-5 is consistently sub-4.5s, introduce a reactive component — coach calls direction at the set position

intermediate.title: Triple Extension Power Day
intermediate.format: Clean / snatch / push press triple extension complex

scaling.easier: DB substitute for all movements; reduce load
scaling.harder: Full versions from floor; increase load 2.5% each session

intermediate.coaching_cue: Triple extension: ankle, knee, hip — all three fire simultaneously.
intermediate.intent: triple extension power development across clean, press, and snatch derivatives
intermediate.progression_hint: Triple extension complex builds explosive hip drive that transfers to every athletic movement; track bar speed subjectively — a slow rep means terminate the set, not grind through it

intermediate.title: Repeated Sprint Ability
intermediate.format: 6 × 6 × 10s all-out sprints with 24s between, 3 min between sets

scaling.easier: 4 sets; 5 sprints per set
scaling.harder: 8 sets; reduce inter-set rest to 2 min

intermediate.coaching_cue: RSA drops fast — if you can't maintain 90% of your first sprint, the set is done.
intermediate.intent: repeated sprint ability training to maintain power output under accumulating fatigue
intermediate.progression_hint: RSA is the most sport-specific conditioning quality — monitor sprint 6 vs sprint 1 output; if drop-off exceeds 10%, the set ends; advance to 8 sets only when 6 sets maintain 90% throughout

intermediate.title: Plyometric Upper Body
intermediate.format: Medicine ball throws + explosive push variations

exercises.exercise: MB chest pass max effort (into wall)
MB overhead slam into rebound catch

scaling.easier: Regular push-up; reduce MB weight
scaling.harder: Single-arm MB pass; band-resisted plyo push-up

intermediate.coaching_cue: The plyo push-up is not a regular push-up done fast — it's a loaded jump.
intermediate.intent: upper-body plyometric power development via ballistic push and throw patterns
intermediate.progression_hint: Plyo push-ups and MB throws build rate of force development in the upper body; advance to single-arm MB pass and band-resisted plyo push-up when all sets maintain airborne hand clearance

intermediate.title: Snatch Balance + Jump Squat Complex
intermediate.format: Contrast: snatch balance + weighted jump squat × 5 sets

scaling.easier: Behind-neck press instead of snatch balance
scaling.harder: Heavy snatch balance + unweighted depth jump to box

intermediate.coaching_cue: Punch yourself under the bar on the snatch balance — don't press it down.
intermediate.intent: contrast training pairing snatch balance with loaded jump squat for lower-body peak power
intermediate.progression_hint: Snatch balance demands overhead stability under rapid descent — a direct test of receiving position; when snatch balance exceeds 90% of back squat 1RM, full snatch from floor is achievable

intermediate.title: Bounds and Hurdle Series
intermediate.format: 4 hurdle drills × 6 passes + bounding complex

scaling.easier: 18-inch hurdles; focus on clearance not speed
scaling.harder: 36-inch hurdles; timed drills

intermediate.coaching_cue: Cycle your trail leg fast — don't drag it over, snap it through.
intermediate.intent: hurdle clearance and horizontal bounding for elastic power development
intermediate.progression_hint: Hurdle series develops reactive strength across both vertical and horizontal planes; timed hurdle passes signal readiness for sprint competition or advanced plyometric blocks

beginner.title: Tempo Squat Introduction

exercises.tempo_note: 3s down / 1s pause at bottom / 1s up / 0s rest at top

scaling.easier: Goblet squat; reduce to 4 reps per set
scaling.harder: 4s eccentric; 2s pause; increase to 8 reps

beginner.coaching_cue: Count out loud if you need to — most people cheat the tempo unconsciously.

beginner.title: Slow Push + Pull

exercises.tempo_note: 4s lower / 2s pause on chest / 1s press / 0s rest

scaling.easier: Floor press instead of bench; reduce weight 20%
scaling.harder: 5s eccentric on both movements; 4 sets

beginner.coaching_cue: The eccentric (lowering) phase is where muscle is built — don't let gravity do the work.

beginner.title: Tempo Deadlift Day

exercises.note: RDL preferred over conventional for tempo — allows controlled eccentric

exercises.exercise: Glute ham raise or Nordic curl

scaling.easier: Single-leg RDL with DB; 4-rep sets
scaling.harder: Conventional deadlift with 3s lower; increase load

beginner.coaching_cue: Maintain tension throughout — going slack at the bottom negates the stretch reflex benefit.

beginner.title: Eccentric-Only Upper Body

structure.note: Use jumping to get to top position — focus entirely on the lowering phase

scaling.easier: Band-assisted; 5s eccentric
scaling.harder: Weighted vest; 10s eccentric; pause at midpoint

beginner.coaching_cue: Eccentric work produces more micro-trauma — you will be sore. Reduce frequency if needed.

beginner.title: Tempo Lunge Circuit
beginner.format: 4 lunge variations × 3 sets × 8 reps with 3s descent

scaling.easier: Bodyweight only; 4s descent
scaling.harder: Hold dumbbells; 4s descent; 2s pause at bottom

beginner.coaching_cue: Front knee tracks over your second toe — don't let it cave inward.

beginner.title: Slow Row + Core Stabilization
beginner.format: Tempo barbell row + plank hold variation

exercises.note: Squeeze every muscle simultaneously — do not just hold position

scaling.easier: DB row; 2s lower
scaling.harder: 5-count pause at top; longer plank

beginner.coaching_cue: The RKC plank should feel impossible after 10 seconds — you're squeezing, not resting.

beginner.title: Tempo Overhead Press

scaling.easier: DB press seated; reduce to 5 reps
scaling.harder: Pause at forehead level on the way up; 5 sets

beginner.coaching_cue: Lock your core before you press — the overhead is a full-body lift.

beginner.title: Full-Body Tempo Circuit

scaling.easier: 4-second count down; 4 reps each
scaling.harder: 4 sets; increase weight when tempo is consistently maintained

beginner.coaching_cue: If you have to break tempo to finish a rep, the weight is too heavy.

beginner.title: Isometric Holds Day
beginner.format: 6 exercises — focus on isometric midpoint holds

scaling.easier: Reduce hold times by 50%
scaling.harder: Add 10s to each hold; weighted vest for push-up hold

beginner.coaching_cue: Isometric force is neurologically intense — expect fatigue with no visible movement.

beginner.title: Slow Eccentric Leg Day

scaling.easier: 3s eccentric; reduce to 4 reps
scaling.harder: 6s eccentric; pause at 90° on squat

beginner.coaching_cue: Slow eccentrics at 60% feel heavier than fast reps at 85% — respect the protocol.

intermediate.title: Hatfield Squat Tempo Protocol
intermediate.format: 5×5 squat at 4-2-1-1 + 3×8 eccentric-only leg press

scaling.easier: 3-sec descent; drop load to 65%
scaling.harder: 5-sec descent; 80% load; supramaximal eccentric on leg press

intermediate.coaching_cue: The 2s pause in the hole is the hardest part — breathe into your belly before you sit into it.

intermediate.title: Supramaximal Eccentric Deadlift
intermediate.format: 4×3 deadlift (110% 1RM) eccentric-only with rack

exercises.note: Start at lockout (from rack); 5s lower to floor

scaling.easier: 100% 1RM; 4s eccentric
scaling.harder: 115% load; 6s eccentric with training partner or safeties

intermediate.coaching_cue: You need a spotter or safeties — this is beyond normal working weight.

intermediate.title: Contrast Tempo Bench
intermediate.format: Alternate: slow bench (5-2-1) and fast bench (1-0-X) × 5 sets each

structure.protocol: Alternate sets — one slow, one fast

scaling.easier: 3 contrast pairs; reduce slow-set load
scaling.harder: Resistance bands for accommodating resistance on fast sets

intermediate.coaching_cue: The contrast primes your motor units — the fast set should feel brutally powerful.

intermediate.title: Nordic Curl Progression
intermediate.format: Eccentric Nordic curls with tempo load — 4×5

exercises.note: Controlled 5s descent; catch yourself at bottom; push back up

scaling.easier: Band-assisted Nordic; 3s descent
scaling.harder: Weighted Nordic (hold plate); 6s descent

intermediate.coaching_cue: The Nordic curl is the most effective hamstring injury prevention exercise — earn the full ROM.

intermediate.title: Slow Single-Leg Day
intermediate.format: 4 single-leg movements × 4 sets at 4-1-2-0 tempo

scaling.easier: 3s eccentric; 5 reps; reduce weight
scaling.harder: 5s eccentric; 7 reps; add load

intermediate.coaching_cue: Single-leg tempo exposes all bilateral compensations — your weak side will humiliate you.

intermediate.title: Tempo Pull-Up Progression
intermediate.format: Weighted pull-up at 3-1-3-1 tempo × 5×4

exercises.tempo_note: 3s up / 1s hold at top / 3s lower / 1s dead hang

scaling.easier: Bodyweight; 2s up / 4s lower
scaling.harder: Supramaximal eccentric: one arm lower (each side)

intermediate.coaching_cue: The dead hang pause increases the difficulty — maintain shoulder packed position.

intermediate.title: Slow Overhead Complex
intermediate.format: Push press / behind-neck press / snatch-grip press at 3-2-1-0

scaling.easier: Drop to 2 movements; reduce tempo to 2s
scaling.harder: Z-press (seated on floor) for all movements

intermediate.coaching_cue: Behind-neck press requires adequate shoulder mobility — test before loading.

intermediate.title: Banded Eccentric Day
intermediate.format: Bands increase eccentric load on 3 main lifts

exercises.note: Bands increase weight as you ascend — more eccentric loading on descent

scaling.easier: Light bands only; reduce bar weight
scaling.harder: Chains plus bands — maximum accommodating resistance

intermediate.coaching_cue: With bands, the top is the hardest — use that to your advantage on the descent.

intermediate.title: Slow-Cook Full-Body
intermediate.format: 8 exercises × 3 sets — all 60-90 min under tension

structure.note: Every set takes 3-4 min due to tempo

scaling.easier: 5 exercises; 3s eccentric only
scaling.harder: 4 sets per exercise; 5s eccentric

intermediate.coaching_cue: This session will feel light but you'll be sore for 3 days — that's metabolic stress at work.

intermediate.title: Time Under Tension Benchmark
intermediate.format: 5 benchmark sets: record TUT target and achieve it

structure.note: TUT = time under tension per set in seconds

scaling.easier: Reduce reps to 6 for all; target 42s TUT
scaling.harder: Increase reps to 10; target 70s TUT

intermediate.coaching_cue: TUT is a training metric — film yourself to ensure you're hitting the counts.

beginner.title: High-Volume Squat Day (Strength)
beginner.format: 10×3 back squat at 75% 1RM with 3 min rest

scaling.easier: 8×3 at 70%; goblet squat substitute
scaling.harder: 12×3; build to 80% on final sets

beginner.coaching_cue: Volume beats intensity for beginners — get 30 quality reps at the same weight.

beginner.title: High-Volume Press Day (Strength)

scaling.easier: 5×4 on each; DB substitute
scaling.harder: 10×4 bench; 8×4 OHP

beginner.coaching_cue: You are accumulating pressing volume — keep every set crisp, even if the weight feels light.

beginner.title: High-Volume Pull Day (Strength)

scaling.easier: 6×4 deadlift; DB row substitute
scaling.harder: 10×4 deadlift with stiff rest periods

beginner.coaching_cue: Back-off volume builds the base — you'll feel this in 4 weeks, not today.

beginner.title: Lower-Body Strength Volume

scaling.easier: Goblet squat + DB RDL; 4 sets each
scaling.harder: Increase to 8 sets on both; add pause

beginner.coaching_cue: Hip thrust lockout — squeeze glutes for 1 full second at the top.

beginner.title: Full-Body Strength Volume Day

scaling.easier: 3×5; drop deadlift from session
scaling.harder: 5×5 at 75%; add 2.5 lb per session

beginner.coaching_cue: This is the classic 5×5. When all 25 reps go up clean, add weight next session.

beginner.title: Push Day Hypertrophy

scaling.easier: 3 sets; reduce to 8 reps; lighter weight
scaling.harder: 5 sets; drop set on final set of each exercise

beginner.coaching_cue: Stop 1-2 reps before failure on every set — chase the pump, not the limit.

beginner.title: Pull Day Hypertrophy

scaling.easier: 3 sets; reduce reps to 8
scaling.harder: Add 1 set; slow eccentric (3s lower)

beginner.coaching_cue: Feel the lat stretch at the bottom of the pulldown — don't just yank.

beginner.title: Leg Day Hypertrophy

scaling.easier: Reduce to 3 sets per exercise
scaling.harder: Superset leg curl + extension; 5 sets

beginner.coaching_cue: Leg hypertrophy requires high reps and short rest — you should want to stop before you do.

beginner.title: Shoulder Hypertrophy Specialization

scaling.easier: 3 sets; 10 reps; lighter weight
scaling.harder: Giant set: all 5 exercises back-to-back with minimal rest

beginner.coaching_cue: Shoulders respond well to high frequency — light weight, lots of reps, feel the burn.

beginner.title: Full-Body Hypertrophy Circuit

scaling.easier: 2 sets; 10 reps; rest 90s
scaling.harder: 4 sets; drop-set on final round

beginner.coaching_cue: Choose a weight you can complete all 12 reps with — reduce if form breaks after rep 8.

intermediate.title: Squat Accumulation Block
intermediate.format: 6×5 squat at 80% + 4×6 front squat at 65%

scaling.easier: 4×5 back squat; drop front squat
scaling.harder: 8×5 at 80%; add chains for final 2 sets

intermediate.coaching_cue: Front squats are humbling — your back squat weight won't transfer directly.

intermediate.title: Deadlift Volume Day
intermediate.format: 5×5 conventional + 4×6 Romanian deadlift

scaling.easier: 4×5 at 75%; drop RDL
scaling.harder: 6×5 at 82%; deficit conventional for last 2 sets

intermediate.coaching_cue: Volume deadlifts test grip as much as back — use chalk, not straps.

intermediate.title: Press Volume Wave
intermediate.format: Wave loading on bench: 4-3-2-4-3-2 with escalating weights

structure.note: Wave 2 starts slightly heavier than wave 1

scaling.easier: One wave; reduce loads 5%
scaling.harder: Three waves; increase load 2% between each wave

intermediate.coaching_cue: Wave 2 at the same percentages feels lighter — let it, and milk the extra output.

intermediate.title: Cluster Set Day
intermediate.format: 5 cluster sets on squat: 3+2+2 with 20s intra-set rest

structure.note: Total 35 reps at 85% — significantly more than standard 5×5

scaling.easier: 3+1+1 clusters at 82%
scaling.harder: Add one more cluster; reduce intra-rest to 15s

intermediate.coaching_cue: Cluster sets let you handle near-maximal weight for more total reps — the pause is the tool.

intermediate.title: Full-Body Strength Accumulation
intermediate.format: 8 compound movements × 4 sets × 4 reps

scaling.easier: 5 movements; 3 sets
scaling.harder: 5 sets per movement; 85% load

intermediate.coaching_cue: This is a 128-rep session at 80% — pacing and recovery between sets is everything.

intermediate.title: German Volume Training — Squat Focus
intermediate.format: 10×10 squat at 60% + 3×10 accessory

scaling.easier: 6×10; 90s rest; reduce to 55%
scaling.harder: 10×10 + single-leg accessory work

intermediate.coaching_cue: Sets 7-10 will feel impossible — that's the stimulus. Stay in the game.

intermediate.title: German Volume Training — Press Focus
intermediate.format: 10×10 bench press at 60% + 3×12 fly and tricep

scaling.easier: 6×10; add rest to 120s
scaling.harder: Superset bench with DB row for all 10 sets

intermediate.coaching_cue: GVT produces massive pump — stay focused on rep quality as fatigue accumulates.

intermediate.title: High-Rep Lower Hypertrophy
intermediate.format: 5 lower exercises × 4 sets × 15 reps

scaling.easier: 3 sets; 12 reps; machine-only
scaling.harder: Drop set on final set; 5 sets

intermediate.coaching_cue: 15 reps at moderate load builds more muscle than 5 heavy reps — research supports this.

intermediate.title: Upper Body Hypertrophy Giant Sets
intermediate.format: 4 giant sets: push-pull A1/A2/A3/A4

scaling.easier: 2-exercise superset instead of 4-exercise giant set
scaling.harder: 5 giant sets; add bicep curl and tricep extension as A5/A6

intermediate.coaching_cue: Giant sets maximize mechanical tension and metabolic stress simultaneously.

intermediate.title: Hypertrophy Full-Body Pyramid
intermediate.format: Pyramid each exercise: 15/12/10/8 reps ascending weight

scaling.easier: 3-step pyramid: 15/12/10
scaling.harder: Descending pyramid after ascending: 8/10/12/15

intermediate.coaching_cue: Each set should take you to within 2 reps of failure — track your weight progressions.
